name: DNS Lookup
description: Query A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, NS and other records, and compare answers across DNS servers
help: Queries run in Rust against the system resolver or public DNS servers, with caching disabled so you always see a fresh answer and timing.
Select several servers to compare their answers side by side, for example to check propagation.
For PTR (reverse) lookups, enter an IP address.
If a proxy in TUN / fake-ip mode is running, answers in 198.18.0.0/15 are placeholders from the proxy, not real addresses.

input.name: Domain
input.ptrHint: Enter an IPv4 or IPv6 address for a reverse lookup.

results.emptyHint: Enter a domain, choose a record type and servers, then look it up
results.fakeIp: Some answers are in 198.18.0.0/15, which proxies in TUN / fake-ip mode return as placeholders. Disable the proxy to see real addresses.

errors.dns.invalid_name: “{{name}}” is not a valid domain name
errors.dns.ip_needs_ptr: {{ip}} is an IP address; choose PTR for a reverse lookup
errors.dns.invalid_server: “{{server}}” is not a valid DNS server address
errors.dns.timeout: The server did not respond in time
errors.dns.system_config: Could not read the system DNS configuration: {{detail}}
